clips.title: The story
paras: Defenders watch Westfall from Sentinel Tower atop Sentinel Hill. Gryan Stoutmantle and the People's Militia organize resistance against bandits, gnolls, and the Defias Brotherhood.

Sentinel Tower rises above the unsettled plains of Westfall. With Stormwind's official army largely absent and aid withheld, local volunteers and veterans joined together around this central stronghold. From its stone heights, lookouts can see across the dusty plains, from abandoned pumpkin patches to the misty shores. They watch for highwaymen and gnoll raiding parties moving through the region.

Gryan Stoutmantle and the local leadership direct the militia from Sentinel Tower. Makeshift defenses surround the stronghold, where wounded refugees and weary soldiers gather, and homesteaders driven from their lands find emergency shelter. Militia members piece together reports about the Defias Brotherhood and organize volunteers into strikes against the syndicate that has brought Westfall to ruin.
